messages.author: f82eb6cf01e30a21
messages.subject: https  Your hosts private data
parts:
Dear Rstudio,

Sometimes I work with people who need someone to analyze private data.  I am intrigued by the idea of creating shiny applications that 
can help them see and think about their own data.  I don't want my clients doing the model development, but I do want them to be able to change certain assumptions the model
makes about the data. I also want to provide them with the ability to do closed loop simulation studies of various choices.  Obviously, at present shiny is not capable of meeting my privacy 
concerns.  However, in the future are you planning to be able to host shiny applications in secure environments?  In addition, if a user wanted to integrate Rcpp with shiny and run something 
moderately computationally challenging (1core 100% for 5min) are you planning to be able to provide service?


Thank you for your help!!!

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: https Your hosts private data
parts: Yes! We fully intend that our forthcoming commercial version of Shiny will be able to accomodate both of your requirements when running on your own servers. We may offer some support for both requirements as part of our (paid) hosted offering as well, but that's more speculative as we have not started the hosting effort in earnest yet.
